reuse.why: Adds the closed-account rule to the existing link precondition every provider already calls, instead of adding a new check per provider.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; the call-site edits are only the rename.

placement.why: Lives in the pre-existing pre-write link guard in accounts/app.ts, which runs before bank creation, writes and sync.

scope.why: Focused; renaming the guard touches five call sites, which is justified by its broader meaning but adds churn.

maintainability.why: One guard named for what it now checks (assertBankAccountLinkable), so future linkability rules have an obvious home.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountLinkable in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFin, Akahu, Enable Banking handlers and by linkBankSyncAccount (PluggyAI, Fintegra)
